answer: Sybil farms depend on one operator posing as many people, so make presence scarce. Each month the registry randomly seats applicants in small live video rooms, and every room meets at the same hour. One person can sit in only one room, so fifty names need fifty real humans. A sable mask, a dune of forged paperwork or a gale of scripted bots cannot attend two rooms at once, and a name nobody met earns no credential.
